title: Moving from Toronto through Florida, Spokane and Seattle
summary: Gil recalls early moves, including a wild Florida hotel run by his mother around 1918.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Now, during our last interview, you established for me in a very interesting way, the fact that you were conceived in Australia but you were born in this Country.
I was born in Toronto, Canada.
In Toronto?
May 13th 1912.
I think, a little louder, the trouble we had........ May what? May, what was the day?
May 13th 1912.
Alright. Now after being born in Toronto, Canada you came to this Country? That's the way it was then? And I do know that you lived at an assortment of places, states that is.
Yes, we did.

And I think that they were very colorful apparently to you or for you and I think they would be for people who are going to be listening to this in years to come. I'm wondering if you might want to talk about some of the very colorful mining camps or lumber camps. Or any of the places at which you spent your time.

I was very young at the time. I don't remember it too well. I only have impressions you know. We lived in Florida for a while. My mother was remarried in Florida. My first step-father was, his name was Gustin and they lived in Florida. My mother ran a little hotel on a road between two towns. I can't remember which, what the

name of the towns were and I think it was Lake Worth and some other town. And in those days it was still pretty wild down there. Because that was around 1918. I can remember at night waking up and hearing the wild horses running by.
Oh really? In Florida?
Yes, right.
In the Everglades then?
And there were alligators around. Rattlesnakes and my mother would scream when she'd find one in the clothes closet or something like that. A few little things like that I remember.

There were some counterfeiters in the hotel. She told the Authorities that they were making counterfeit money. All kinds of various places like that. They were just, I don't really know how to describe them except they were just like you'd think they would be really. Just ......
Now you've been in lots of cities of course since then. I just simply started out with that kind of thing because....
Yes, I never lived in a city, we didn't live in a city for a long time.
But I mean since you've
The first city we lived in was Spokane but then when we left Spokane again we didn't live in the city for quite a while. And the next time was Seattle. And from there we went South to California.
